caption:
The video captures an outdoor basketball court at dusk, its blue surface marked by a maroon key and ringed by a chain-link fence. A glass backboard and red-rimmed hoop stand at the right, with trees and light poles beyond. A man in a white long-sleeve shirt and grey shorts holds a one-arm follow-through pose as the ball rests at the rim. The ball then drops from the net toward the court while the man lowers his arm.

As the ball continues its descent, it falls clear of the rim. It reaches the court surface near the right side of the maroon key, where it comes to rest with only small shifts in position. The man, having lowered his arm, adjusts his footing. He then moves across the key from the left, closing the distance to the stationary ball. The camera framing stays fixed throughout, holding the hoop, fence and court lines constant. The man stands on the right, facing the resting ball, with no pickup visible.
